negative_reviews.author: Bonnie Wong
negative_reviews.text: Not happy about the food and quality, chicken karaage was served warm-cold, ramen wasn't cooked enough still raw and jammed together, but got the noodles replaced after complaint. Overall, not recommend

negative_reviews.author: Court Berry
negative_reviews.text: Came with friends today around 4:30pm. Service was so poor, server seemed like he wasn't interested in us at all. Waited ages to order then received our meals before our drinks on the hottest day of the week. Ramen had hardly any toppings, wasn't worth it at all. Also the railing going down the stairs at the bottom is hanging off the wall nearly causing one of my friends to fall over.

negative_reviews.author: Steven Joseph
negative_reviews.text: If you've eaten ramen in Japan, this ramen doesn't compare unfortunately. Service was good and they are nice, but the flavors and food are nothing special.
